security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Node-based visual programming for local AI
bundle.longDescription: Cyberloom is a desktop application for building programs by wiring typed blocks together on a canvas. Models, runtimes, senses, memory and actuators are blocks; a wire carries a type; everything runs on your own machine unless you say otherwise.
